name: The Ossoor
signature_dish: Akki rotti with spicy condiments and estate filter coffee
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of the restaurants in Sakleshpur on Tripadvisor — a rustic highway cafe set on the edge of the 1,200-acre Ossoor coffee estate on the Bengaluru-Mangaluru highway at Kollahalli. The akki rotti with spicy chutneys, eaten on the balcony with estate views, plus the estate's own coffee, are exactly what Bengaluru-Mangaluru road-trippers stop for.
insider_tip: It is a highway stop, not a town restaurant — perfect mid-drive break. You cannot go inside the estate, but the cafe and coffee store are open to all. Pick up the homemade chocolates, local honey and coffee from the attached shop. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: The Ossoor, Bengaluru-Mangaluru Highway, Kollahalli, Sakleshpur, Hassan District, Karnataka 573127

name: Durgashree Mess
area: Old Market Road, near Halesanthaveri Circle, Sakleshpur
why_it_matters: A modest family mess just off the highway near Halesanthaveri Circle, started about 21 years ago by Vishalakshi Lokesh and her late husband and now run with their son Sujith. Vishalakshi cooks to recipes learned from her mother in Bengaluru, adapted to native Malenadu tastes — the homestyle nati donne biryani and mutton keema unde are the dishes food bloggers single it out for.
insider_tip: It is small and the biryani is cooked in limited batches — come at lunch and order the keema unde (mutton meatballs) alongside. Properly homestyle Malenadu cooking, not a polished restaurant. Cash and UPI; carry small notes.
signature_address: Durgashree Donne Biryani Mess, near Halesanthaveri Circle, Old Market Road, Sakleshpur, Hassan District, Karnataka 573134

name: Mythri Restaurant
area: B.M. Road, near KSRTC bus stop, Sakleshpur town
why_it_matters: A pure-veg restaurant at Pushpagiri Comforts near the KSRTC bus stand on the Bengaluru-Mangaluru highway through Sakleshpur — the convenient town veg stop, with a separate family room. Reviewers come for the rice rotti (akki rotti) and neer dosa, the Malnad-leaning veg dishes on a standard South-and-North-Indian menu.
insider_tip: Right by the bus stand, so handy for KSRTC arrivals. Akki rotti reviews are mixed — order it fresh and ask for it thinner if you like a crisp one. Family room at the back is quieter. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: Mythri Restaurant, Pushpagiri Comforts, B.M. Road, near KSRTC Bus Stop, Sakleshpur, Hassan District, Karnataka 573134

name: Imperial Heritage
why_it_matters: A sit-down restaurant on B.M. Road at Kollahalli, running since 2013 — the more comfortable mid-range option in a town otherwise full of utilitarian highway eateries. Reviewers describe a homely heritage feel with good local Malnad dishes and warm service.
insider_tip: Better for an unhurried meal than a quick highway pit-stop. Local Malnad dishes are the reason to come; the menu also runs to standard multi-cuisine. Dine-in, takeaway and delivery. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Imperial Heritage, B.M. Road, Kollahalli, Sakleshpur, Hassan District, Karnataka 573134

name: Surabhi's Nx
why_it_matters: A clean, modern pure-veg restaurant on B.M. Road (the Bengaluru-Mangaluru highway through Sakleshpur) — reviewers repeatedly call it the cleanest, most hygienic veg option in town, a refreshing gem on a highway lined with rough-and-ready eateries.
insider_tip: The clear pick for families who want a tidy, hygienic veg stop. The South Indian mini meals are the order. Reasonably priced and quick. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: Surabhi's Nx, B.M. Road, Sakleshpur, Hassan District, Karnataka 573134
